findings.text: Address classifier distinguishes kernel executable locations from other addresses. Core kernel text is accepted directly, while module, trampoline, kprobe slot and BPF locations are accepted through dedicated oracles. An extended variant additionally accepts init text useful for preserved traces. Results are boolean with true meaning printable as kernel text.

Classification that may run where RCU is not watching must temporarily enter an NMI-like watching state around oracle consultation and leave it afterwards, so module and BPF oracles that require watching remain safe during traces, warnings or CPU state transitions.

Function descriptor resolver leaves pointers outside the kernel operation descriptor range unchanged and otherwise delegates to the generic descriptor dereference helper, providing transparent handling for architectures with and without descriptors.
Fault injection context associates a list linkage for global tracking with a kprobe probe carrying the target name and address plus a stored numeric substitute result to be forced on failure.

A single mutex serializes all fault injection list mutation, lookup, validity checks and replacement-value access, held across sequence iteration and across inject control updates and held inside value get and set paths.

Substitute results are normalized according to the injectable type of the target address. Null type forces zero, true type forces one, errno types constrain values to the valid negative errno range with fallback to invalid argument, otherwise the caller value is preserved.

Injection points move between absent, armed and triggered. Arming resolves a symbol name, validates injectability and uniqueness, registers a probe and publishes list and debugfs state. Triggering probabilistically overrides the return path with the stored value. Disarming removes debugfs state, unregisters the probe and frees context, singly by prefixed name or entirely by blank input.

Debug control surface exposes a top fault control with an injectable list alias and an inject file for arming and listing, plus a per-symbol directory containing a replacement-value file. Listing shows probed addresses symbolically, and value files reject updates for stale contexts or values inconsistent with the target error type.
Each fault injection probe installs an empty post handler alongside its pre handler specifically to inhibit jump optimization that cannot support return-path overriding.
Minimum thread count floor is twenty.
Maximum thread count ceiling derives from the futex TID mask.
Per-CPU cached thread stack slots number two.
Vmalloc stack allocation uses kernel reclaimable zeroed memory with KASAN skipping.
Fork implementation requests trace point creation.

Process population accounting maintains a monotonically increasing fork total and a live thread count excluding idle threads with a tunable upper bound, plus per-CPU process counters aggregated by summation over possible CPUs.
A cacheline aligned read-write lock guards the global task list as the outermost synchronization in its nesting order.

Task lifecycle caches include dedicated slab caches for task structures, signal state, shared signal handling, files, filesystem context, address spaces and thread stacks, with task and signal caches private and others shared across files.
Vmalloc stack tracking pairs an RCU callback head with a pointer to the associated virtual area, allowing deferred release after grace period with optional cache return.

Vmalloc thread stacks are sourced from a node-aware per-CPU cache when possible and otherwise from fresh virtual allocation, with memory cgroup charging, sanitizer state handling and clearing of reused contents. Release attempts cache return under preemption protection and locality checks, falling back to RCU deferred virtual free with metadata clearing.

Alternate stack implementations provide contiguous page allocation and slab cache allocation respectively, each pairing allocation with null clearing on free and RCU deferred reclamation to physical pages or to the slab cache.

Task stack release requires the task to have reached the dead state, otherwise it warns and deliberately leaks rather than freeing prematurely. Reference-counted put drops to release only on last reference.

Final task teardown releases execution-related and architecture-specific resources, including user CPU affinity, shadow call stack, IPI mask, stack storage, tracing and filter state, kernel thread context, BPF storage and execution state, before returning the task structure to its cache, with warnings for unexpected filter, stack reference or separate stack remnants.
Kernel thread context cleanup tolerates missing allocation from earlier failure, clears the worker linkage and frees the name and context, warning if block cgroup state remains attached.

Shadow call stack release is a no-op when disabled or absent, otherwise it checks for end corruption and usage before returning the area to a per-CPU cache or atomic virtual free, with accounting in kilobyte units against the owning node.
Task IPI mask teardown does nothing when the mask is inlined, otherwise it frees the dynamically allocated mask pointer.

Address space duplication propagates the executable file reference from old to new space and attempts to deny write access, emitting a one-time warning if denial fails while relying on prior denial by the source.

Address space identifiers and page tables have both active and no-op configurations. Active page table handling allocates and frees via architecture helpers with out-of-memory propagation. Active identifier handling allocates from a bounded IDA range and frees with dummy, bounds and double-free protection.

Cached stack access runs under preemption protection with atomic exchange or compare-exchange for insertion and removal, while actual virtual or page reclamation is deferred through RCU callbacks safe for interrupt context.
Resident accounting names file, anonymous, swap entry and shared memory counters through a stringification helper indexed by type.

Shadow stack usage monitoring is compiled out unless debug usage is enabled, otherwise it scans from base toward magic for nonzero words, tracks a global highest watermark with relaxed compare-exchange and logs task identity on new highs.
Thread stack slab cache creation establishes a cache sized and aligned to the thread size with full user copy range and faults if creation fails.
